root_idea.summary: The root centers on pouring or letting something flow out, especially from above.
root_idea.development: From pouring, the lexical field extends to downward flow and descent, things rushing or descending upon others, gathered portions imagined as flowing together, and remnants understood as what has been poured out or remains after pouring.

senses.definition: To pour out, pour forth, or cause a liquid or other substance to flow down.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for pouring something out or down, including a substance poured from above onto a recipient. Voice and aspect vary across the Quranic occurrences.

senses.definition: To pour punishment or affliction upon someone; to inflict it heavily.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with عَلَى and an object such as punishment or a destructive visitation; it extends the image of something poured down upon its target.

senses.definition: Pouring out or forth; a pouring.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used to intensify or characterize the act of pouring; in the Quranic context it describes rain being poured abundantly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay down or hand over a price or sum of money at once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative transitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower or let down a rope into a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction used when lowering a rope to draw water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bend down the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attested expression associated with prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put the legs into shackles; to shackle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the passive expression for a person's legs being put into fetters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on or clothe oneself with a coat of mail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is armor or a coat of mail, which is put onto oneself or another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw oneself upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with عَلَيْهِ expressing a forceful rush or attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour forth wealth or benefit to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which wealth is treated as something poured toward its recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be annihilated, made to pass away, or done away with.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or quasi-passive use said of a person or thing; this Classical use is distinct from literal pouring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To descend into a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative extension of downward flow, used with a valley or similar declivity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dart, stoop, or rush down upon a target.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a serpent, hawk, falcon, or wolf rushing upon prey or another target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be overcome by passionate love, attachment, desire, or ardor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى or بِـ for intense desire or tender attachment toward someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take one's way down a declivity or sloping place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV, said of a company of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink the remainder of liquid in a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of water, milk, or another beverage remaining in a container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To outlive someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction likening the remaining span of life to the last liquid in a vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour or flow out, forth, or down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive Form VII is used of water, sweat, blood, and similar fluids descending or flowing; it can also suggest repeated or abundant flow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or assemble at a water source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative use said of people coming together at water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slope or descend downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a place, ground, or similar surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline toward diversion or amusement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with إِلَى describing a person's inclination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour out liquid for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII, used for drawing water from a waterskin or pouring oneself a cup.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To annihilate, do away with, or disperse something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A special reduplicated formation; the object may be a thing, an army, property, or wealth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scatter or disperse an army, property, or wealth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific extension of destroying or breaking up what is gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass or go away, or become annihilated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a thing; of night, day, or heat, it can mean that most of it has passed away, leaving only a small portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become reduced in quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of what remains in a waterskin or milk-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dispersed or scattered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a company of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become very bold, daring, adverse, or hostile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, especially with عَلَيْنَا for hostility toward us.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become intensely hot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pouring forth or poured forth, used as an epithet for water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or epithet use corresponding to pouring or being poured; it is distinct from the verbal-noun function of the Quranic nominal occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A downward or descending blow with the edge of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression ضَرَبَهُ ضَرْبًا صَبًّا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a numerical expression, a quantity below a stated number, or according to another reported usage, above it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A disputed idiomatic usage in expressions such as ضَرَبَهُ مِائَةً فَصَبًّا; the direction of comparison is reported differently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affliction or trial poured upon someone from above.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal construction describing the descent of hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person affected by passionate love, attachment, desire, or tender ardor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet, with feminine and plural forms attested in Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported idiom, serpents or companies rushing or pouring upon one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The interpretation and derivation are disputed: the expression has been explained of serpents darting down to bite, or of companies pouring into mutual slaughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quantity or mass of wheat, food, or similar material poured out together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote a collected quantity formed by pouring material together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A food cloth or article on which food is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported naming connection based on food being poured into or onto it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company, detached group, flock, herd, or small collected portion of property or goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people, horses, camels, sheep, goats, money, wheat, food, or a small portion of wealth; exact numerical ranges vary by report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part or portion of the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for a portion of the night having passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The downward descent of a river, rivulet, channel of water, or road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun describes movement down a declivity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A declivity, sloping ground, or a stretch of sand that descends or pours downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place or surface down which one descends; plural forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pouring, flowing, or descending; a form with an intensive sense of such flow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival form related to pouring out, forth, or down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water poured or flowing forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may function adjectivally or as a substantive for poured-out water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blood or sweat poured or flowing forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are reported substantive uses for what flows out of the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expressed plant juice or red dye used for coloring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported identifications include dragon's-blood juice, sesame- or henna-leaf juice, safflower, and several dyeing plants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hoar-frost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independent Classical nominal use attested in a description of the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good or excellent honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported substantive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extremity of a sword, especially the end associated with its flowing or cutting action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also refer to the sword's flow or discharge more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessive love, attachment, desire, or tender ardor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive corresponding to the passionate-love use of صَبَّ and صَبّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small remainder of water, milk, wine, or another beverage left in a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended metaphorically to a remaining portion of life or another remnant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick, large, and strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet applied especially to a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard or severe journey, especially one without delay, interruption, or flagging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of journeys described as قَرَب or خِمْس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What remains of a thing, or what is poured out from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of the remainder or discharge from a waterskin or milk-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dialectal epithet or name for the month Rajab.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as apparently a dialectal variant of الأَصَمّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where water or another substance pours out, such as an outlet, confluence, discharge point, or sink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for water flowing from a river, tank, gutter, or high ground into another channel, the sea, or a hollow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported attribution with no supporting authority identified in the lexical discussion.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence صَبًّا at 80:25 is a verbal noun; its contextual rendering as “in abundance” does not create a separate lexical sense.
The reported interpretation of صُبٌّ in the serpents-and-conflict expression is disputed, and alternative derivations are preserved in its usage conditions.
The ship meaning of مِصْبَاب is reported with no authority identified in the lexical entry.
Historical Lane citations were not converted into modern Quran verse locations; Quran examples use only secure QAC locations.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane:entry:25213 contains competing explanations of صُبٌّ; it is represented as a reported disputed expression rather than assigned to a single uncontested etymology.
lane:entry:25228 reports مِصْبَابٌ meaning “ship” while explicitly noting that supporting authority was not found; it is retained with that limitation.
